tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg me shel rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mtha' bral dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab dang / /dmigs med snying rje zung 'jug gsal ba'i mdangs/ /gang 'dul khro chags sna tshogs skur bzhengs pa'i/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'dud/ /lha mnyes byed cing sdig sgrib bung shing bsregs/ /gsang sngags nus 'byin tshogs gnyis gzi 'bar ba'i/ /sbyin sreg cho ga me shel 'dir gsal bya/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis dge legs stsol/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus gang rung rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing nyes sgrib zhi ba la sogs pa'i phan yon mang po dang ldan pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ de la sbyin sreg rnam pa gnyis yin te/ phyi dang nang du 'dir bzhed do/ /phyi'i rnam pa dgu yin te/ /gang gis gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de la phyi'i sdom la ni/ /thab dang rdzas dang dgang blugs dang / /sgrub po mchod yon dgod tshul dang / /me brtsal cho ga phan yon no/ /nang gi zur du shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po thab ni/ rang ngam bla ma gong mas sa chog mdzad de/ dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs mdzad pa'i gnas yin na mi dgos la/ de lta bu ma yin pa'i bar dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar gyi sa chog byas par/ phyag dar dang rkyang nul bya/ ba byung la sogs pa dri zhim pos byugs/ gzhung las sbyin sreg gi khang pa dang / thab brtsigs pa sogs gsungs la/ de tsam ma grub na rdul tshon bya/ bla bre sogs kyi mchod rdzas dang / yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku sogs brten mchog kyang ci 'byor bshams/ de la thab bri tshul la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ khru phyed kyis dbus nas zlum por skor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol tu sor bzhi bskor ba kha khyer dang /

slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang / slar yang sor bzhi tsam bskor ba pad+ma'i sa'o/ /zlum bskor phyi ma de nyid dang tshangs thig 'dzom pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la/ thag bzhi'i rtse legs par sbrel ba'i stegs bu gru bzhi dang / de'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyis cha kha gru bzhi pa mdzad pa ni/ bri cha la mig sngar mdzes pa dang / sgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi nang dum bu gsum du bgos te/ zlum bskor gsum gyi phyi ma ni sngar gyi dngos gzhi'i zlum bskor dang 'grig nang ma gnyis gsar du legs par bskor la/ cha phyi ma la pad 'dab bcu drug de yang thig chen brgyad kyi bar rnams phyed phyed du bgos pas bcu drug 'byung / des 'og tu yang shes par bya'o/ /bar pa sa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ lte bar rdo rje sngon po/ rdo rje ma gtogs gzhi thams cad dkar po/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ mu ran gyi phyir pad 'dab bcu drug bri'o/ /thab kyi dbyibs gsal zhing mdzes pa'i phyir bcad tshon thams cad kha dog dmar skyas bya/ de las gzhan pa'i lha'i mtshan ma mang po 'god tshul gzhung na mi snang bas/ lha thams cad rdo rje gcig pu las dus gcig tu rdzogs nas gsal 'debs pas de la dgongs sam snyam mo/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe/ thabs kyi gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan par go bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bud shing la sogs pa'i rdzas ni/ 'dir zhi ba'i bud shing la/ gzhung du ba la sha dang / u dum wa ra sogs mtshan nyid rgyas po bshad kyang / de tsam ma 'byor na tsher ma can ma yin pa'i shing / 'o ma can nam srog chags med pa'i lci bas/ thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng na zlum por brtsigs la/

nang du 'jig rten shar lho'i mtshams su'am/ zan las byas pa'i ting lo che ba zhig kyang bsham la bzhag rdzas rnams kyang gzhung nas khyad par ba mang po gsung ba gang 'dzom dang / 'og tu dgos pa rnams bsags/ gsum pa dgang gzar blugs gzar gyi mtshan nyid gzhung du 'byung zhing / gang na'ang ci 'byor pa'i dgang gzar blugs 'dus bya'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub po'i khyad par ni/ khrus byas pas/ dri zhim pos lus la byugs pa/ brtse ba dang / byams pa dang ldan pas kha dog dang mthun pa'i shel la sogs pa'i rgyan dang / dar ram ras sogs kyis gos dkar po dang ldan pas 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor dang / bsrung ba'i cho ga dang / bzlas pa dang bcas shing / tha mal pa'i gtam smra ba bcad pas/ shin tu 'jam pa'i stan la pad ma'i 'dug stangs kyi bsdad de/ 'dir bsrung ba zhes 'byung ba ni/ spyin sreg byed pa'i dus la bsrung ba bdun gyis bsrung ba bya ste/ gser sa le sbram dang / mu tig la sogs pa mig ma phugs pa/ ghi haṃ gur gum gyis bris pa'i rten 'brel snying po dang / rma bya'i sgro la rma bya chen mo'i yangs snying bzlas pa/ yungs kar dang yi ge muṃḥdang k+ṣiṃ gser gyis bris pa lus la btags pa dang / zhes pa lta bu'i rang gis gang shes kyi bsrung ba'i bye brag spro na bya mod/ gtso bor rang he ru ka'i nga rgyal la go cha gnyis la sogs pa gsal ba nyid bsrung ba'i cho ga yin no/ /srod la kha shar du phyogs pas sdig pa dang bar chad sogs zhi bar mos pa'i bsam pas/ dkar po'i tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ zhi ba'i yid kyis bya'o/ /lnga pa mchod yon rnams bshams pa'i skabs ltar ro/ /drug pa dgod tshul ni thabs kyi mtha' bskor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byugs/ thab kyi zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan pa'i mdun du rang gi stan nang tshangs can dkar po bya/ de'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar mdzes pa'i steng du/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas g.yon du rdo rje dri bu dang /

de'i bar du dgang gzar blugs kha sbyar la bzhag thod pa sogs su nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba g.yon phyogs su'o/ /ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ rnam rgyal las bum gnyis/ dgos mchod dang bcas pa dkyil chog bzhin bshams/ thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa wam̐ yig bris pa/ rgyar mtheb sor bcu gnyis/ dpangs su mi'i sked tsam sleb pa zhig bshams/ de nyid dngos gzhi'i tshe ri bo gangs can du bsgoms pas/ bdag gi tshad gdung dang khyad par me lha 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa yin la/ de spyan drangs pa na/ de'i rjes su 'brang shing mes mi gnod pa'i 'byung po rang brgyud pa du ma 'ongs nas/ sgrub pa po la 'tshe bar byed pa'i tshe 'di nyid gangs rir bsgoms pas gnod pa des mi tshugs pa'i ched yin gsung ngo / /rang gi g.yas thabs kyi g.yon nas/ gzhung du rdzas kyi bye brag du ma gsungs kyang / gnad don rdzas chen bcu gcig tu 'dus pas de bshad na/ yam shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo mar dang sbrang rtsi dang dri bzang gis byugs mar til zas zho 'o ma mngar gsum bsres mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dūr ba ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bshams/ /zhes so/ /rdzas thams cad las thams cad pa'i sngags swā hā'i mtha' can bzlas shing bdud rtsi gtor/ mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas sogs yo byad thams cad gu gul gyis bdugs/ gtsang sbra gal che rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas gsang gtor la sogs pa'i chu gsum la/ 'o ma til dkar/ 'bras nas/ me tog dkar po/ ku sha gur gum rnams btab pa dang / de dag gi mdun du nya phyis la sogs pa'i gzer zhal gsum snod stong pa ma yin par/ shing tog gam 'bru cung zad blugs pa bshams/ de nas me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod rnams bshams/ dri mchog la tsan+dan dkar dmar/ dri bzang po la sogs pa'i bsil sman btab/

gsang gtor dang dri mchog la ku sha'i 'thor yab kyang bzhag me lha mchod pa la mchod pa tshar gcig kyang bshams/ sbyin sreg gi skabs su gtor ma ni gzhung na gsal kha mi snang la/ sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs su dgos pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam gcig mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ zho 'o ma mar gsum sogs bsres pa'i tsa bzang po zer ru'i zhal zas mtheb skyu mi dgos rgyan dang ldan pa/ mthar sha chang sgog tsong ma gtogs kha zas bzang dgu gang 'byor dang bcas pa bshams/ mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags swā hā'i mtha' can brgya bzlas te bzhag bdun pa me btsal ba ni/ rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ shing 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o/ /de lta bu'i me de snod du 'dus byas/ gal te me de sgrub thabs ma rdzogs kyi bar du sdod du mi btub na mar me la spar te bzhag kyang rung / gang na'ang / rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol te sum+bha ni sogs kyi sngags bzlas la bsrung ba byas te bzhag me lha la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i 'byung po rnams la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas gtor ma phul te sbyin sreg gi cho ga mthar ma phyin gyi bar gyi bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ muḥgang dag nag po'i phyogs kyis sogs brjod/ nag phyogs rnams bskrad par bsam la/ dril bu drag tu dkrol/ sum+bha ni sogs bzlas/ yi ge gsum bzlas pas me snod bsrung / dug rigs ma yin pa'i rtsa skam po gzhan dang / dpal 'bar che ba zhig bsham mo/ /brgyad pa cho ga'i rim pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ lag pa byin rlabs/ nang mchod byin rlabs/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ maṇ+ḍal byin rlabs/ gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba/ cho ga'i sngags dang phyag rgya/ phyag 'tshal ba rnams dang /

gtor chog ltar gtor ma phul/ dag pa gsum nas brtsams te sgrub thabs rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i bar du legs par nyams su blang ngo / /de dag gi skabs su 'od zer gyi spro bsdu dang / bzlas pa'i sngags rnams las gzhi gang dang 'brel pa'i kha dog tu bya dgos pas 'dir zhi ba la dkar po bya'o/ /de nas rnam rgyal dang las bum dkyil chog ltar bsgrub/ las bum gyis bsang chu bya'o/ /'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar du lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab/ bsreg rdzas byin rlabs 'og tu bshad kyang 'dir drangs na bde bas/ las bum gyi chu rdzas rnams la gtor te hūm̐ ngam/ 'khyil ba gang rung brjod pas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsreg rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba so so'i las bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing / yi ge gsum gyis byin rlabs/ khyad par du lag pa gnyis khu tshur sbyar te gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing / oṃ shrīḥswā hās mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swā swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs zhing byin gyi rlabs so/ /de nas gong du bshad pa'i me dpal 'bar la spar te/ lag pa gnyis gus pa'i tshul gyis thabs la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zheng / ngag tu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod la/ oṃ dz+wa la dzā la raṃ/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo spar la/ yam shing mar la sbags pa'am/ rtsa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas me gso/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gis phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pa dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyi mar bud shing la khyab par lan gsum byugs te gtso bo'i snying po shrī badz+ra he he sogs lan gsum dang /

dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis a mṛ ta'am/ hūm̐ ring po brjod/ thab dang yo byad thams cad la las bum gyi chu gtor te bgegs bsal/ me gso ba la dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ ngam/ hūm̐ ring po brjod cing rlung g.yab kyi me sbar/ khas sbus na mi gtsang bar 'gyur bas mi rung gsung ngo / /gzhung las skabs 'dir ku sha 'bul ba 'byung zhing / sngags tsam las ma bshad kyang / tshigs bcad sogs kha bskangs te/ de yang / ku shā'i chun po brgyad gong nas bshams pa de/ las bum gyi chu gtor te hūm̐ brjod pas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ thab dang yo byad rnams kyis 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /des bdag la bgegs med cing zhi bar mdzod gcig oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes brjod cing thabs kyi mdun nas phyogs g.yon skor dang / mtshams g.yas skor du thab stegs kyi steng nas dgram mo/ /de nas thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po/ rgya khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ de'i dbus su 'dab ma sor bcu drug pa'i pad+ma'i steng du/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ dpangs su sor gcig yod pa la/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas mtshan pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan cing / mu ran gyi phyi rol nas pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug gis bskor ba/ phyi rol stegs bu grub bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan zhing bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis yongs su gang ba las me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/

'khyil pa'i sngags saṃ/ hūm̐ gis las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las byung ba'i me'i phung po gru gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la pad+ma dang / nyi ma la gnas pa'i raṃ gyi yi ge las byung ba'i me lha'i drang srong phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pas dbyug to dang me'i thab 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas spyi blugs dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba la/ sma ra dang ral pa'i tshogs can gsus pa 'phyang ba/ lug la zhon pa/ zhi ba'i rgyan dang gos dang / 'od kyi phreng ba dang rnam par shes pa dang / rnam snang gi cod paṇa gyis rgyas btab pa dang ldan pa'i snying gar raṃ gyis mtshan pa dam tshig sems dpa'i sa bon dang / rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gnyis ka las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ me'i phyogs kyi nam mkhar byon/ de ltar bsam zhing lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas las/ mthe bong nang du bkug pa g.yob pa'i tshul bya zhing / oṃ e h+ye hi ag+na ye raṃ/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha dz+wa la dz+wa la ho/ ma hā ri ṣa sarba de wa mu khā pu riṃ/ asmi san ni hi ho bha wa hūm̐/ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ de dang lhan cig 'ong ba'i bgegs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i khwa gdong ma la sogs pas bsal bar bsams te/ bsangs chu 'thor zhing / sum bha ni brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig pa la dbyer mid du thim par bsams/ de nas/ oṃ āḥpa d+yaṃ hūm̐ tā pa ne ye grih+na hūm̐ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ oṃ baṃ ā tsām+pa naṃ dri ṣa ye pra yats+tsha hūm̐ gis zhal bsil/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ka ḍa ki ni sa ma yā ar+ghaṃ dā mi hūm̐ hūm̐ raṃ raṃ swa hās mchod yon rnams dbul/ las dang rjes mthun pa'i mchod rdzas rnams kyang dkar po'i rnam pa can gyis mchod par bsams zhing /

o badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shap+ta hūm̐ gi bar dang / oṃ badz+ra bī nī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni gzhung las/ ku sha'i dkor bzhag dang snod kyis/ /gsum pa'i thog mar gsang gtor te/ /thams cad byed pa'i bzlas pa'i chus/ /de bzhin du ni zhabs bsil blugs/ /khu tshur kha phub byas pa yis/ /mdzub mo'i me tog yongs bzung ste/ /mthe'u chung dang ming med dang / /gung mdzub rim gyi phye bas dor/ /gnyis pa'i dung gi ar+gha ni/ /bzhes bzed snod ni gnyis par ro/ /rdo rje thal mo rab phye bas/ /gsum pa ru ni zhal bsil sbyin/ /mthe bong mdzub mo btsir ba yi/ /me tog bzung ba'i khu tshur gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mngon sum du/ /lan gsum bskor ba 'jug rim gyis/ dbye ba mdzub mo gung mo dang / ming med dang ni mthe'u chung ngo / /zhes bya ba ni brgyud pa'i gdams pa'o/ /rig ma bcu drug gi phyag rgya ni gzhan dang mthun no/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam dgang blugs kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzar bu'i kha la raṃ bsam ste/ oṃ āg+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la bdun tshan gsum gyis mar dbul zhing / bdun tshan re re'i mthar/ oṃ de ba ṛ ṣi sa ra sau ga ta kā ru ni ka ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐/ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes dang / sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥ shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du/ sarba bi gha nam bh+yaḥ shān+tiṃ༞ sarba ro ga༞ sarba duṣ+ṭan༞ sarba gra he༞ sarba dz+wa re༞ sarba byā dhi༞ sarba ud pa dra we༞ sarba a ka la smā+-ir+yu༞ sarba dur sob ni༞ sarba dur mi tai༞ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ las sngags kyi spel tsheg 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/

/de nas me pra brtags pa ni rgyas par gzhung rnams su shes par bya zhing / shin tu bsdu na/ me dkar zhing gsal ba/ 'jam zhing dri zhim pa du ba chung zhing yid du 'ong ba ni dge la/ du ba 'tshub cing dri ngan la/ tsheg sgra 'byin pa ni ngan no/ /me bkra ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsangs chus phyogs kun du gtor te/ bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas yaṃ shing la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin/ lag pa g.yon du bzung la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blangs shing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang / yaṃ shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhi bhik+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang de'i rig pas shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā til lam yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zas mchog oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swā hās 'bras so ba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hās 'bras/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hās nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro/ oṃ ma hā bā lā swā hās sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hās dūr ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul la/ sde mtshan re re'i mgor me lha'i sngags oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa gsum lnga la sogs pa brjod cing / mthar spel tshig bdag gis gsang sngags kyi lhag chad dang / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad pā paṃ bh+yaḥ shān+tiṃ ku ru zhes sogs gong ltar brjod/ bsreg rdzas sde tshan re re yang bdun nam nyer gcig brgya sogs gang 'byor phul/ de la til brgya nges par 'gro dgos shing / gzhan ci nus so/ /de nas mchod pa rnams sngar bzhin dang / nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyis sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog

/'byung po yongs su bskyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rjes dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg ba'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rigs sngags tshul gyis bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /bdud rtsis rgyun gyi ghan+dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /shes rab chen pos bdag med thugs chud cing / /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas drang srong cha lugs 'dzin/ /'jigs byed me lha khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba/ /bdag gzhan don 'byor pa la bzhugs/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la/ oṃ āḥpā d+yaṃ sogs kyis zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil sngar ltar phul/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swā hā/ zhes dang lag gnyis sor mo lnga ka so ltar bsgrigs pa'i phyag rgyas tam bu zhes pa so rtsi phul/ mar gzar bu gang thab tu blugs te shin tu mnyes par bsams/ de nas/ me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'am/ de'i thugs khar dkyil 'khor bsgom pa 'dam kha can yin na'ang / rgyud las thugs khar bsgom pa dngos su 'byung bas de bzhin bya/ de yang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs sngar ltar byin gyi rlabs la/ me lha'i thugs khar paṃ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i steng du raṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ ljang sngon yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gis byin gyi rlabs pa/ de las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros te/

'gro ba thams cad dag par byas te mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du sems can re re yang byas nas/ de rnams gdod ma nas grub pa bem po ma yin pa'i sems can las 'das pa thams cad bkug ste/ de nyid du zhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥka ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥzhes brjod la/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su zur drug pa'i chos 'byung gi dbus su/ ri rab sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i sogs nas/ bskal pa bzang po pa rnams la pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ zhes pa'i bar dang / dbus su bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs nas/ rgyu skar sna tshogs dang bcas pa yongs su gang ba zhes pa'i bar dang gtso bo'i thugs khar nyi ma la sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dgug gzhug gi bar dang / thugs kha'i sa bon las sogs kyi dbang lha spyan drangs te/ bcom ldan de bzhin sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' mo rnams kyis dbang bskur rol pa'i sogs/ dpa' bo rnams kyis phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ de'i tshe rdo rje dril bu bsil zhing / me tog gtor/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi skabs su me long dkyil 'khor la bstan te rnam rgyal bum chus dbang bskur ba dngos su bya/ tshigs ris rnams chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rnam snang / yum sogs nas dbu rgyan gyi bar gzhan rnams 'dra/ rang gi thugs kha nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ rig ma bcu drug dang / gau rī ri dwags sogs dang / bstod pa rgyas pa byed na sngags 'phreng yongs rdzogs dang de tsam mi nus na/ mtshan brgya'am/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa'am/ shin tu bsdu na rkang brgyad gnyis so/ /nang mchod kyang phul/ dkyil 'khor bde ba chen por sogs bsgo ba'i glu blangs/

de yan chad sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar yin pas shin tu zhib pa gal che'o/ /de dag dang dus mnyam du/ steng gi cha la rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung nor lha'i tshogs sprin phung thibs pa bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang bsdud pa'i sgo nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad pa ni/ 'od zer rnams kyi rtse mo las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa nor bu zla 'od kyi bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bas rang gang yin skabs dang sbyar dang sgrub bya sogs la dbang bskur bas nad rims gdon bgegs sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ zhes brjod cing yun ring du dmigs pa bsgom/ de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsreg rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi gtor te/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du dmigs/ gzar bu gnyis blangs te/ lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs snying po lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la sngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyi mar blugs pas/ dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ yag+na ye a dī bya ya dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya swā hā/ bdag gis gsang sngags kyi lhag chad zhes sogs/ spel tshig gong ltar brjod de/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyis zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum bya/ de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī ḍa ka sa ga ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra kun la sbyar ba'i gsang gtor nas rol mo'i bar dang / dril bu dkrol te/ dharma ra ṇi sogs brjod/ rig ma bcu drug dang / nang bdud rtsis mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig bya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg dngos gzhi'i rdzas bsogs pa ni/

rtsa sngags la sogs pa lha thams cad la bsnyen pa rgyas par song ba'i rnal 'byor pa yin na/ lha rang rang gi lha sngags sngon du btang zhing / bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i kha skong rdzas sngags til la 'dzin mjug tu las sngags spel tshig sbyar de yang kha skong gi grangs ni til 'ba' zhig la 'dzin/ rdzas gzhan rnams brgya re dbul de lta bu'i bsnyen pa dang / sbyin sreg rgyas po byed mkhan deng sang nyin skar bzhin du snang ngo / /skal bzang gang zhig spros pa gzhan bzhag te/ /lo dang zla ba mang pos 'di nyid la/ /'bad na lag len rgyas pa yong bar snang / /blo ldan snying rus ldan rnams de dgongs 'tshal/ /da ni mdor bsdus pa'i lag len snying par dril ba ni/ yaṃ shing nas brtsams te/ rdzas thams cad kyi thog mar gtso bo'i snying po'am/ bsnyen pa song na nye snying yi ge bdun ma'ang rung / de gnyis gang rung tshar gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang / mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa phul la/ logs nas sgrub g.yogs gcig gis grangs gzung / bsnyen pa kha gso ba la sogs pa'i dus su/ nub re la til gyi grangs ni rang gis phreng ba la bzung zhing ting phor sogs su bsags te brgya phrag re song ba dang thab tu 'bul ba'i phyag len snang / stong phrag lnga'i khri la sogs pa ji tsam nus pa 'bul/ skabs skabs su yam shing mar ci 'byor 'bul/ sgrub g.yogs gcig gis me ma chad tsam gyis bud shing yang 'jug bsdus pa 'di la rdzas rnams lha thams cad la dus gcig tu phul bar bsam rgyu yin/ de yang / thams cad du zhu ba'i rdzas ni zhal du/ yaṃ shing dang mi'i rus pa la sogs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la'o/ /zho'i bza' ba dang zas sna tshogs dang / zhal bsil dang til la sogs pa ni phyag tu'o/ /dri ni thugs khar ro/ /me tog ni dbu la'o/ /bdug spos ni 'bar ba la'o/ /zhabs bsil ni zhabs dag la'o/ /mdun du mar me dang mchod yon kyang ngo /

/mchod yon gyi chu ni phyi rol gyi snod du blugs/ me lha'i skabs su yang 'di bzhin shes par bya'o/ /bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang / gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos byin gyi rlabs te/ nus na mchod phreng ltar bya/ mi nus na gong ltar bya dgos kyi mchod pa yang phul/ tam bu la sngar ltar phul la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ dman pa la sogs pa'i skyon zhi bar bya ba'i don du bzod par gsol ba ni/ bdag blo rmongs pas cung zang 'bri/ /gang byas nyes pa la ni slar/ /gang zhig lus can skyabs rnams kyis/ /mgon pos de nyid bzod par gso/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis dang / /ma rnyed pa dang yongs ma shes/ /bya ba 'di ltar byas pa 'dir/ /de dag thams cad bzod par rigs/ /zhes pas bzod par gsol la mngon par dga' ba'i dngos grub blang ba ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis rgyud byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ skabs 'dir he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus dang / oṃ badz+ra sa twa aḥ zhes pa yang lan bdun bzla bar gzhung las bshad/ mthar oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi rjes la oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang / mtheb srin gyi se gol gyis sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ dam tshig pa'i lha thams cad dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa'i thugs kha'i 'od zer sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams sdig pa dang bral bar byas te/ slar 'dus lha so so la thim pas sku shin tu gsal bar byas par bsams/ de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi thabs kyi thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral ba mgrin pa snying gar reg la/

rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer gyi tshogs lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas dam tshig gi lha'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ de nas thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang / dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod de/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha shin tu gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ gong ltar mchod bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul/ mthar gong ltar mar dgang blugs bdun bdun tshan gsum spel tshig dang bcas pa phul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed na/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu gzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg phul ba'i mthar/ yon bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i nad dang gdon dang bkra mi shis pa/ byur dang ska ba ngan pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o/ /'khyil pa bzlas pa'i bsrung skud de'i lag par bcings la bsangs gtor bya'o/ /de nas sngar gyi rtsa ru'i za ba la ba dan btsugs/ gza' ba dang btung ba sna tshogs chab kyis bran/ bsang chu gtor te 'khyil pas bsang / swa bhā wa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i bdud rtsis rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ de nas zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang / oṃ dī bya ag+ne sa ma dhi dh+ya na pri ṇa ni swā hā/ zhes brjod de/ phud bla ma yi dam sogs la phul bar mos te rten drung / mchod gral la bzhag de nas dum gcig me lha la thab tu dbul/ mchod bstod gong ltar byas la/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes sogs rang gang 'dod kyi gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / oṃ ag+na ye sarba san+to ṣa ṇi ku ru me ya thā kā le sid+dhi dā gats+tsha tu hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bya bas gshegs su gsol/ de nas tsa ru de rang yang bza' zhing slob ma rnams la'ang bgo bar bya'o/ /de lta na'ang 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsol ba yi/ /lhag mas sdig rnams 'joms pa'o/ /zhes brjod la sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig dang ldan pa 'dus pa tshogs kyis ston mo bya'o/ /de yang gzhung 'di nas gsungs pa/ gzhon nu mdzes ma gar byed dang / /sna tshogs sil snyan rnam bkrar byas/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan rnams kyis/ /skye bo chen po brtson bzhin dang / /me tog spos sogs kyis spro bar/ /'dus pa'i dbus su bya ba'o/ /taṃ bu la kun thams cad la/ /dgyes byed sbyin par bya ba yin/ /zhes so/ /de nas go cha rnams gsal te dag pa dran pa/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /rang gis bsnyen pa kha gso lta bu mchog gi dngos grub kyi don du yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul zhing shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la/ gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la phral du phyags la/ thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung dang nye bar 'brel na rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs pa'i cho ga dang sbyar te/ de'i rdul tshon 'di zhes par/ sbyin sreg gi thal bar 'don par sgyur ro/ /nang gi sbyin sreg dang dbang rgyas la sogs pa gzhung du 'byung zhing / rgyu mtshan rgyas pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdor las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bshad sogs la blta bar bya'o/ /dgu pa phan yon ni/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad skong zhing nus pa 'byin/

/sdig sgrib bar chad zhi nas lha mnyes shing / /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /de skad du rgyud las/ bsod nams tshogs kyi rgyu don dang ye shes tshogs rdzogs bya phyir ro/ zhes gsungs so/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sbyin sreg me shel rab 'bar zhes bya ba 'di ni khams ston blo gros rab tu gsal ba shes rab lhun grub kyis nan chen pos bskul zhing / yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ dge slong snyoms las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis dngos po'i lo gro bzhin zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan du sbyar ba'o/ /paṇa chen dza ya se nā'i gzhung bzang dang / /tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung rab la brten nas/ /bris kyi rang bzo'i nyes pa med snyam mod/ /'on kyang zab don byis blo'i yul min phyir/ /nyes pa'i tshogs kun sngon bsags sdig sgrib dang / /lhan cig yul mchog rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /'bad pa'i dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ /tshogs gnyis snang ba rgya cher 'bar gyur cig /i daṃ sha sa na tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu/ bkra shis dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 14 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg me shel rab 'bar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 15
